toolbarHint: Built-in channels follow the Zcode client; custom channels can be managed here
genBadgeV2Hint: Channel system v2: custom providers (provider_config.json) are shared with the client and editable in the plugin with instant effect; official account channels (OAuth sign-in) are resolved and activated by the plugin
emptyHint: Configure models in the Zcode client, or edit the config file and refresh
customKeyBadgeHint: A custom apiKey override is configured for this provider (~/.zcgui/config.json); session requests use it
customKeyHint: Manually set the apiKey for {{provider}}. Session requests will use this key (provider baseURL and model list still follow the ZCode client config). Team plan users: create an API key in your team project on the BigModel open platform and paste it here to use team quota.
customKeyPlaceholder: Paste API key (empty + save = clear override)
customKeyClearHint: Empty input: saving clears the custom key and restores client config
customKeyKeepHint: No custom key configured: saving an empty input changes nothing
customKeyApplyHint: Takes effect immediately (new sessions use this key)

section.builtinHint: Follows the ZCode client config; only one is active at a time — switch in the client. The trial plan requires human verification (CAPTCHA) and cannot be used in this plugin, so it is excluded
section.reorderHint: Use arrows to reorder (synced with the client)

builtinReadonlyHint: Built-in channel active (enable/disable in the ZCode client)
providerNoModels: No models configured for this provider
disableHint: Disable this provider (writes config.json; chat model dropdown syncs immediately)
enableHint: Enable this provider (writes config.json; chat model dropdown syncs immediately)
disableModelHint: Disable this model (writes provider_config.json; hidden from the chat model dropdown on sync)
enableModelHint: Enable this model (writes provider_config.json; selectable in the chat model dropdown on sync)
testTitle: Test this model's connectivity (sends one minimal request)

dialog.removeProviderBody: Delete channel "{{provider}}"? Its {{count}} model(s) will be removed too.

viaSelectedHint: The channel currently selected in the ZCode client (authoritative)
viaFallbackHint: The client-selected channel has no valid credential; fell back to the first usable builtin channel
viaFallbackCaptchaHint: The trial-plan channel requires CAPTCHA (slider) verification, which the plugin cannot complete; fell back to the first usable builtin channel (personal plan / API key)
showKeyTitle: Use the eye icon to reveal the full key
teamNoOverrideWarn: Team plan is selected in the ZCode client but no team key is configured — requests are billed to the personal plan key
overrideOnPersonalWarn: Custom key is active — the key configured in the ZCode client is not in use
customKeyClearNote: After clearing, requests use the key configured in the ZCode client (or the OAuth token)

preset.title: Add Provider
preset.hint: Pick a provider to auto-fill the base URL, protocol and model list — just paste your API key. Or start from a blank form.
preset.addedHint: This provider has been added; adding again creates a duplicate entry you can disable or delete

editor.name: Channel Name
editor.inLockedHint: Text input is always enabled (same as the Zcode client)
editor.outLockedHint: Output is fixed to text (same as the Zcode client)
editor.errUrl: Base URL must start with http(s)://
editor.errModels: At least one model is required
editor.errContext: Context must be a positive integer
editor.errOutput: Max output must be a positive integer
editor.contextHint: Context window drives the auto-compaction threshold — fill it per official docs; overstating it causes failed compaction or context overflow

lastModelBody: "{{name}}" is the last model of channel "{{provider}}" and cannot be removed on its own. To stop using this channel, delete the whole channel via the trash button on the channel card.
remigrateTitle: Migrate built-in channels (with keys) from the legacy config.json
remigrateConfirmBody: Reads built-in channels that carry a plain API key from the legacy config.json and creates them in the current channel list (including context window and vision/video/PDF flags). Existing channels are not migrated twice.
remigrateNoneBody: No migratable channel in the legacy config (a plain API key is required)
